messages:
nina: quick async standup — kernel change landed to reduce slot-steal; ran a microbench against rlp-2 and saw ~6% p95 improvement. blocker: KV warmup still noisy on ~16k shards, repro steps below.

omar: nice! what was the slot allocator change? diff or PR? :eyes:

nina: small tweak — prefer-fill instead of round-robin when free_slots < 8. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/merge/732 (comments inline).

leslie: pushed a KV eviction heuristic tweak to staging a few hours ago (LRU bias + age penalty). canary looks OK but need more runs. can we add it to the smokewave canary?

pat: re: warmup noise — are we priming prefixes or relying solely on KV prefetch? i think increasing prefetch window to 128 for the first 2m might help.

nina: current prefetch window is 64. i'll try 128 in a canary and run the bench. command i used: ```./bench --model rlp-2 --seq 2048 --runs 50 --kv-prefetch 64``` will rerun with --kv-prefetch 128.

ciara: kick off long job now (runs 10x over varying seqs). if it stabilizes i'll post the p50/p95/time-series to the perf dashboard. ETA ~25m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

bench-bot: perf run finished for nina's canary (kv-prefetch=128): p50 18ms -> 17ms, p95 72ms -> 67ms, throughput +4%. artifacts: gs://redwood-perf/1888888000/rlp2/ (traces + flamegraphs).

omar: sweet — any memory delta on the canary?

leslie: staging showed +0.8% resident on average; no OOMs. i left a note in the PR about the memory tradeoff.

pat: followups: (1) nina plz attach the smokewave canary config to the PR, (2) leslie let's confirm rollback steps if eviction causes tail regressions, (3) ciara please tag perf graphs with shard-count and warmup window.

nina: ack. i'll: attach canary, run one more 50x sweep with eviction+prefetch=128, and leave a short checklist in the PR for rollback (revert config, scale-down canary, rollback stash). planning a 15m sync if numbers diverge — ping me here.

ciara: will post graphs + a short recap when done.

bench-bot: note: automatic alert suppressed — transient p99 spikes on one host during run, likely unrelated to code change (network IRQs). added event to incident log.

nina: thanks all — no blockers from me after the next perf sweep. otherwise handing off to leslie for eviction tuning validation. :white_check_mark:
